export_evidence: No export bill-of-lading found. ImportKey page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/gct-pharma-research-india-private-limited) reports 'Total Shipments 113 Records detected' and 'Latest Cargo 2026-02-21', but every visible row is an INBOUND record: e.g. '2026-02-21 | PPD CENTRAL LABS C/O THERAPAK A DIVISION | GCT PHARMA RESEARCH (INDIA) PRIVATE LIMITED | ... | PRAGUE RUZYNE, CZECH REPUBLIC | DELHI AIR CARGO ACC INDEL4, India | 84716050 | 7680574' — origin Czech Republic, destination India, i.e. import, not export. Port lanes confirm inbound only: 'PRAGUE RUZYNE 60 / DELHI AIR CARGO ACC INDEL4 60' and 'LONDON HEATHROW 49 / SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC INBOM4 49'. Source counter: page claims 113 shipments; only 5 rows were actually rendered in the free view, and 0 of those 5 are outbound. No export record with an Indian port of loading was seen.

note: Role is a clinical-trial / central-lab logistics intermediary, not a manufacturer or exporter: the visible customs traffic is FOC/NCV clinical-trial consumables (scanners, EDTA kits, pregnancy test kits, printed forms) arriving from PPD Central Labs (Prague) and Imperial CRS International (UK) into Delhi Air Cargo and Sahar Air Cargo. Declared HS 300290 (pharma products) does not match any observed record — observed HS codes are 84716050, 49119990, 39239090, 38221910. Per project rule 3 this is NOT grounds for rejection: company stays in the base, HS should be corrected to the actual observed codes, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. No traces of supply shipments found in either direction: no export B/L and no verifiable domestic supply evidence — the only confirmed activity is inbound clinical-trial material. Revenue and export volume: null (not public).
